title: 第25章 关系决裂第26章 好感度50奖励宝箱
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: 闻听此话，叶峰一时间也不知徐墨说的是真是假。
毕竟今天发生的许多事情，都已超过了他的认知。
徐墨说完，也不在乎叶峰信不信，直接催动真正的万古钟，陡然发出一声响彻灵魂的亘古钟鸣。
钟鸣使得空间都掀起阵阵涟漪，径直攻向叶峰。
叶峰见状，来不及过多思考，赶忙催动万古钟，同徐墨的攻击抗衡。
轰！
霎时间，两道亘古钟鸣猛地撞击在一起，恐怖的余波瞬间笼罩圣子大殿，使得整座大殿都开始震颤。
一时间，两道钟鸣竟然不分伯仲。
然而随着时间的流逝，叶峰的那口万古钟竟然开始剧烈震动起来，所发出的钟声也开始出现断层。
砰！
下一刻，在叶峰不可置信的目光下，万古钟忽然发生了一声巨响。
一道极其恐怖的声响陡然出现，只见叶峰的那口万古钟，竟然直接爆炸开来！
这个变故显然让叶峰始料未及，身体直接被爆炸余波殃及，如同断了线的风筝般，飞出十数米远。
浑身上下满是大大小小的伤口，鲜血直流。
“叶哥哥！”
柳如烟见状，顿时满脸焦急，赶忙跑过去查看。
叶峰依旧与刚才一样，直接推开柳如烟，大吼道，“我跟你说了，别在碰我！”
见叶峰真的生气了，柳如烟刚伸出的手僵在半空，有些难以置信地看着他。
然而叶峰对此却置若未闻，只是挣扎着起身，对着徐墨嘶吼。
“徐墨，这到底是怎么回事？我的万古钟为何会爆炸！”
“你猜呢！”
徐墨呵呵一笑。
等等，难道你给我的万古钟也是假货！”
叶峰思索片刻后，忽然想起了什么，瞳孔骤然收缩。
“恭喜你，答对了！”
徐墨笑了笑，将万古钟收回。
闻言，叶峰只感觉自己浑身的血液都沸腾起来，他双眼通红，死死盯着徐墨。
“徐墨，你的心好狠啊！”
说完，又将目光转向柳如烟，咬牙切齿道，“还有你这个贱女人，竟然联合徐墨一起害我，我以前真是瞎了眼！”
“我没有，我真的没有！”
柳如烟不听地摇头，哭着解释道。
“还敢说你没有，有毒的圣丹，伪造的圣器，这些可都是你给我的。
我都已经这样了，你还不承认！”
柳如烟双眼通红，哭得更厉害了。
“我真的不知道啊，圣丹有毒我不知道，圣器是假的我也不知道。
叶哥哥，请你一定要相信我……”
“哈哈哈，真是好一个不知道。”
闻听此话，叶峰顿时被气得癫狂大笑。
在他眼中，柳如烟怕是在一周前就与徐墨有染了，此等事她绝不可能不知道！
而他更是一个极其自负之人，所谓爱有多深，恨就有多深。
现在他只想和柳如烟一刀两断。
“柳如烟，今日我叶峰与恩断义绝。
从今日起，你我之间再无任何关系！”
在叶峰说完话的瞬间，徐墨脑海中的岁月之书便产生异动。
content_en:
After hearing this, Ye Feng didn't know for a moment whether what Xu Mo said was true or false.
After all, many things that happened today exceeded his understanding.
After Xu Mo finished speaking, he didn't care whether Ye Feng believed it or not, and directly activated the real eternal bell, which suddenly sounded an eternal bell that resounded through the soul.
The sound of the bell caused ripples in the space, and it went straight towards Ye Feng.
Seeing this, Ye Feng didn't have time to think too much and quickly activated the Eternal Bell to counter Xu Mo's attack.
boom!
In an instant, two ancient bells collided violently, and the terrifying aftermath instantly enveloped the Holy Son's Hall, making the entire hall begin to tremble.
For a moment, the two bells sounded almost indistinguishable.
However, as time passed, Ye Feng's eternal bell began to vibrate violently, and the sound of the bell began to appear faulty.
Bang!
The next moment, under Ye Feng's disbelieving gaze, the Eternal Bell suddenly made a loud noise.
An extremely terrifying sound suddenly appeared, and Ye Feng's eternal bell exploded!
This change obviously caught Ye Feng by surprise, and his body was directly affected by the aftermath of the explosion, flying more than ten meters away like a kite with its string broken.
His whole body was covered with large and small wounds, and blood was flowing freely.
"Brother Ye!"
When Liu Ruyan saw this, his face suddenly became anxious, and he hurried over to check.
Ye Feng was still the same as before, pushing Liu Ruyan away and yelled, "I told you, don't touch me!"
Seeing that Ye Feng was really angry, Liu Ruyan's outstretched hand froze in mid-air, looking at him in disbelief.
However, Ye Feng ignored this and just struggled to get up and screamed at Xu Mo.
"Xu Mo, what is going on? Why did my eternal clock explode!"
"What do you think!"
Xu Mo chuckled.
Wait, could it be that the eternal clock you gave me is also a fake! "
After Ye Feng thought for a moment, he suddenly remembered something and his pupils suddenly shrank.
"Congratulations, you got the answer right! "
Xu Mo smiled and took back the Eternal Bell.
Hearing this, Ye Feng felt that the blood all over his body was boiling. His eyes were red and he stared at Xu Mo.
"Xu Mo, you are so cruel! "
After saying that, he turned his eyes to Liu Ruyan and gritted his teeth and said, "And you, a bitch, actually teamed up with Xu Mo to harm me. I was really blind before! "
"I didn't, I really didn't! "
Liu Ruyan shook her head and cried as she explained.
"I dare to say that you don't have it. The poisonous holy elixir and the forged holy weapon were all given to me by you.
I'm already like this and you still don't admit it! "
Liu Ruyan's eyes were red and she cried harder.
"I really don't know. I don't know that the holy elixir is poisonous, and I don't know that the holy weapon is fake.
Brother Ye, please believe me..."
"Hahaha, what a great unknown. "
Hearing this, Ye Feng was immediately so angry that he laughed maniacally.
In his eyes, Liu Ruyan was probably having an affair with Xu Mo a week ago. There was no way she wouldn't know about this!
And he is an extremely conceited person. The so-called love is as deep as the hatred.
Now he just wants to make a clean break with Liu Ruyan.
"Liu Ruyan, today I, Ye Feng, have severed all ties with En.
From today on, there will be no relationship between you and me! "
The moment Ye Feng finished speaking, the Book of Years in Xu Mo's mind moved.
